body:
## [3.109.0] - 2026-11-11

### Features

- fit resized fields and delete saved templates
- add vertical gap for continuous feed
- add template field toolbox and undoable clearing
- create templates from default and edit sizes in millimetres
- refresh printing data and preserve in-progress edits

### Bug Fixes

- synchronize retained purchase quantities after refresh
- preserve reviewed work across refresh and rounding
- defer root lifecycle effects during account changes
- defer router refresh until provider updates settle
- return to account login after printing logout

### Other Changes

- Updated partial results: Retry is now the large primary button; Done is the smaller outlined button.
- restore the VPS runner for development PRs
- The exchange flow now: 1. Sends return_items and requires success. 2. Asks the cashier to remove returned items from the RFID box, leaving purchases inside. 3. Waits 4 seconds after confirmation. 4. Sends neutralize for purchased items only.
- enclose print guard in a block
